commands.command: Verify Studio recovery, dedicated main-API avatar generation and targeted regression tests
commands.stdout: Recovered /studio and /mobile/group_chat: HTTP 200. User systemd service enabled, active/running; lingering enabled. Initial dedicated avatar call returned HTTP 502 with an empty model response at provider-default reasoning. After selecting the lowest supported reasoning level, the real frontend proxy returned HTTP 200 in 5.82s with a validated 3025-byte SVG. Backend regression suite: 182 passed and 57 subtests passed; added PUT forwarding and quiet second-cycle avatar sync regressions: 11 passed and 8 subtests passed. Avatar browser cases: 4 passed; Studio/mobile/Dynamic UI cases: 8 passed. Initial browser failures were incorrect selectors and test navigation, corrected without weakening application checks.
